fees.notes: UNIMAS official international undergraduate programme fee (Faculty of Applied and Creative Arts): tuition RM3,500/semester + recurrent RM1,620/semester + non-recurring RM1,280 = RM37,120 total for 7 semesters. per_year = total / 3.5yr nominal duration. Source: https://www.global.unimas.my/admission/undergraduate (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.english_requirement: IELTS 5.5 or equivalent (MUET Band 4, TOEFL iBT 46, PTE 51, Cambridge 160)
